events.title: Mastercard Foundation Commits $500 Million to Transform Higher Education in Africa
events.description: The Mastercard Foundation has committed $500 million to transform higher education in Africa, aiming to create jobs for the rapidly growing youth population.

events.title: Liberian authorities burn $336 million in cocaine as senior police officials are implicated
events.description: Liberian law enforcement agents have burned some 4.2 metric tons of cocaine worth about $336 million.

events.title: Poland says 'nuclear capable' missile from Russia exploded in country
events.description: The incident has raised fears of a wider conflict between Russia and NATO.

events.title: Migrant Surge in Ceuta
events.description: Thousands of migrants have surged into Ceuta, a Spanish enclave in Morocco, prompting the Spanish government to deploy its military to the border.

events.title: Cuba opens pharmacies, gas stations to private firms
events.description: The move is part of Cuba's efforts to liberalize its economy and attract foreign investment.

events.title: US issues sanctions targeting support networks for Iran's Mahan Air
events.description: The US has issued sanctions targeting support networks for Iran's Mahan Air.

events.title: Blast at Pakistan coal mine complex kills eight, dozens missing
events.description: At least eight coal miners were killed and dozens still missing after an explosion buried parts of a mining complex in Pakistan's Balochistan province.

events.title: UEFA threatens World Cup boycott over FIFA private equity investment plan
events.description: FIFA has faced backlash from global soccer governing bodies over the proposal to allow private investment in the World Cup.

events.title: US and China discuss trade, rare earths in call ahead of Xi visit
events.description: The call is part of efforts to improve relations between the two countries ahead of Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit to the US.

events.title: US launches strikes on Iran after attempted missile attacks
events.description: American fighter jets launched air strikes against Iran after attempted missile attacks on U.S. forces in Jordan.

events.title: UEFA to boycott World Cup over FIFA proposals
events.description: UEFA member federations agreed to boycott all FIFA competitions in protest of Gianni Infantino’s plan to sell stakes in the World Cup to private equity investors.

events.title: Thousands of migrants enter Spanish enclave from Morocco
events.description: Thousands of migrants streamed across from Morocco into the tiny Spanish territory of Ceuta on Thursday.

events.title: European nations agree to boycott World Cup
events.description: European nations have agreed to boycott the World Cup if Gianni Infantino goes ahead with selling off part of the tournament to private investors.

events.title: Egyptian fencing team defeats Israel to claim World Championship team bronze
events.description: The Egyptian national sabre fencing team secured the bronze medal after defeating Israel with a score of 39–38 at the World Fencing Championships.

events.title: Pakistan ‘doing its utmost’ to bring U.S., Iran back to negotiating table
events.description: Pakistan's Foreign Office said the country is 'doing its utmost' to bring the US and Iran back to the negotiating table.

events.title: Negotiators working on final roadmap for Gaza’s future, Hamas disarmament
events.description: Negotiators are working on a final roadmap for Gaza's future, including the disarmament of Hamas.

events.title: Death toll tops 1,500 in fastest-growing Ebola outbreak
events.description: The outbreak declared on May 15 is unlike most previous Ebola outbreaks because the Bundibugyo virus responsible for it has no approved vaccines or treatments.
events.location: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo

events.title: Iran vows to punish the aggressor after US strikes
events.description: Iran has vowed to punish the aggressor after the US unleashed a heavy wave of strikes, with the conflict drawing in new countries.

events.title: Bank of England keeps key rate at 3.75% for the fifth time this year
events.description: The Bank of England has kept its key interest rate on hold for the fifth time this year after a bigger-than-expected drop in the inflation rate last month gave policymakers breathing space to assess the future of the economy.

events.title: Malaysia begins screening refugees for return to Myanmar
events.description: Malaysia has started documenting and screening detained Myanmar nationals as part of a repatriation program.

events.title: Poland says Russian ballistic missile violated airspace
events.description: Polish authorities have said that a Russian ballistic missile crashed within its borders during Moscow's overnight attacks on Ukraine.

events.title: Cuba to Trump: We’re Open for Business
events.description: A top Cuban official says the island won’t negotiate its politics, but it is willing to talk investment, including from President Trump.

events.title: NATO member scrambles fighter jets as Russian attack on Ukraine kills 8
events.description: Poland scrambled fighter jets after a suspected Russian Kh-101 missile entered its airspace during a massive barrage of over 70 missiles and 280 drones.

events.title: Pope Leo Says He Hopes to Visit U.S. Within ‘Next Couple of Years’
events.description: Pope Leo XIV said that he had been looking at the calendar for the 'next couple of years' to plan a visit to the United States.

events.title: Brazil Federal Debt Tops US$1.8 Trillion in June
events.description: Brazil's federal debt reached R$9.268 trillion (~US$1.82 trillion) in June 2026, a 2.61% monthly increase.

events.title: Iran vows to ‘punish the aggressor today’ after U.S. unleashes ‘heavy wave’ of strikes
events.description: The conflict appeared to draw in new countries, as Egypt confirmed that a drone hit two natural gas vessels at one of its ports.

events.title: Brazil El Niño Plan Injects US$262M to Stockpile Corn, Rice
events.description: Brazil's government has announced a plan to stockpile corn and rice to mitigate the effects of El Niño.

events.title: Pakistani police post attacked
events.description: A militant attack on a police post in northwestern Pakistan left 11 officers and 15 attackers dead.

events.title: US launches strikes on Iranian targets
events.description: The US military says it has completed what it describes as a heavy wave of strikes against Iran conducted in response to an earlier Iranian missile attack on a US base in Jordan.

events.title: Nepal's tiger population more than triples in 16 years
events.description: The population of tigers in Nepal has increased from 121 in 2010 to 429, according to the WWF.

events.title: China threatens retaliation against US humanoid robot ban
events.description: China's Commerce Ministry said the US Federal Communications Commission has repeatedly ignored Beijing's restrained stance, and the ban 'severely damages' relations.

events.title: US launches fresh airstrikes in Iran
events.description: The US military conducted a heavy wave of airstrikes in Iran on Wednesday evening, targeting its Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps in response to attacks on American military bases in the Middle East.

events.title: Russia launches ballistic missile attack on Kyiv
events.description: Multiple explosions rocked Kyiv after Russia launched ballistic missiles, hours after Volodymyr Zelenskyy warned of a massive overnight assault.
